QUESTION:
Our payroll integration still uses REST API v1. Will it stop working the day we upgrade to 5.0?

CANDIDATE A:
Yes. API v1 has been removed in 5.0, so the integration will break.

CANDIDATE B:
No. API v1 still works in 5.0 and 5.1 (with a Deprecation header); it is removed in 5.2, planned for May 2027.

RESPONSE:
Answers are taken from the release notes themselves. Three points in my earlier notes were wrong, and I've marked where.

**1. Can we open a 3.8 company file directly in 5.0?**
No. 5.0 cannot open company files from 3.x or earlier. You need to:
1. Install version 4.6.
2. Open and save each company file in 4.6 so the database gets converted.
3. Upgrade to 5.0.

The 4.6 installers stay on the Downloads page until 30 June 2027. Take a backup before upgrading, because older versions cannot open the 5.0 database format.
*(Correction: my notes wrongly said you could upgrade directly from any earlier version. Direct upgrades only work from 4.0–4.9.)*

**2. Minimum macOS version?**
macOS 12 Monterey. macOS 11 Big Sur is no longer supported.

**3. Will Starter plan bank transactions sync automatically?**
No. Automatic bank feeds (every four hours) are only on the Business and Enterprise plans. On Starter, you still import bank transactions manually from CSV, OFX or QIF files.
*(Correction: my notes wrongly said automatic sync was on all plans.)*

**4. Will the API v1 payroll integration stop working when we upgrade?**
No. API v1 still works in 5.0 and 5.1, though every v1 response now includes a "Deprecation" header. It will be removed in version 5.2, planned for May 2027. Move the integration to API v2 (documented on the developer portal) before then.
*(Correction: my notes wrongly said v1 was removed in 5.0.)*
